subject: jollyform
use_case: Mobile dynamic form layout, schema orchestration, and validation engine
problem: Standalone form engine viability vs full-chain requirements
risks: Market squeeze: developers write thin custom form hooks or adopt full-stack SaaS form builders.
Unbundled form engine lacks persistence, submission queues, and analytics.

evidence.value: Market judgement: discounted as a standalone product. Retained strictly as an internal engine.

decision: Retired as a standalone commercial product. Retained as an internal core engine for the app. People require the whole chain (from visual design through storage and analytics) or build custom; standalone package distribution is discontinued.
revisit_when: Only if complete end-to-end form backend and cloud submission storage are packaged together.
